summary: Former fire lookout on Allegheny Mountain, Bath County, Virginia; FFLOS-registered 2018 as US 1707, VA 14 and listed as gone. No build, removal or staffing dates in sources read.

facts.status_note: Forest Fire Lookout Association Virginia list marks it Tower Gone; the register entry gives no removal date

access.note: No source read says whether the public may reach the site, and none describes what remains there.

events.note: Added to the Former Fire Lookout Sites register January 15, 2018; nominated by Brian Powell

evidence.supports: lookout located along Allegheny Mountain on the Virginia/West Virginia border; the only description given
evidence.quote: This lookout was located along Allegheny Mountain on the Virginia/West Virginia border.

evidence.supports: list gives same register number, marks tower gone, nearly the same coordinates
evidence.quote: High Top Bath 38.06931 -79.95608 Tower Gone FFLOS US 1707, VA 14

notes_for_editor: Two sources only: the register entry (one-sentence description, no build, removal or staffing data) and the FFLOS Virginia list. The story is short because the evidence is. The Forest Lookouts Virginia list shows an undated 'High Point' lookout in Bath County with no detail; not checked against this site and not used. Brief record checked: status gone, elevation, registration date and nominator are correct; no corrections.
